name: Thanatrel
description: A lipid-soluble compound that binds to cardiac SNT-interface receptors and introduces progressive fibrotic scarring indistinguishable from idiopathic cardiomyopathy. Administered once, it works over 18-26 weeks, causing the target to die of apparent heart failure. Standard autopsy panels do not flag it; only a targeted Thanatrel-specific assay — which no routine coroner orders — will find it.
effects: leaves no foreign compound signature after week 8
side_effects: target experiences fatigue and mild dyspnea in final weeks — consistent with cover diagnosis
extremely rare accelerated timeline (death within 6 weeks) if target has pre-existing SNT cardiac augments
handler risk: dermal contact without glove liner causes self-dosing
duration: 18-26 weeks to fatal outcome; compound clears bloodstream within 72 hours of administration
cultural_context: The preferred tool of corporate succession murders and political eliminations in GLMZ's Tier 4-5 world. Deniability is the product — Thanatrel doesn't sell death, it sells a natural cause. Fixers with Spire clientele treat it as a premium service item. Coroner corps are rumored to have a standing agreement with certain Nightshade distributors to keep the assay off standard panels.
story_hooks: A Tier 3 cardiologist notices an uptick in idiopathic cardiomyopathy deaths among mid-level corporate managers — all rivals of the same Tier 4 executive. She doesn't yet know what she's found.
A fixer is hired to source Thanatrel, then discovers the target is someone they know personally. The patch is already in their pocket.
A Nightshade quality-control chemist attempts to sell the targeted assay formula to a forensic corp — and goes missing before the deal closes.
